text:
alex: Heads up — since ~02:30 UTC we've seen a spike in gRPC stream resets through the us-west-2 edge LB. Client errors show `grpc: connection error: desc = \"transport: received unexpected GOAWAY frame\"` and lots of `CANCELLED` on streaming generate requests. Rolling window shows ~1.6% error rate on streaming RPCs. Anyone seeing LB/backplane alerts?

maria: Looking now. Any correlation with recent node restarts or autoscaler events? What clusters and node pools?

sam: I pulled edge-proxy logs for the affected prefix. Getting a lot of HTTP/2 GOAWAY with `last_stream_id=...` and `error_code=NO_ERROR` followed by upstream resets. We also have multiple 502s. Envoy logs include `stream closed` messages. My hunch: idle timeouts or buffering edge-case on long-lived bidi streams.

jamie: FYI we merged a change last week that adjusted Envoy flush behavior for long unidirectional streams — there was a subtle buffering regression (see PR #4021). Canary got v1.18.2-hotfix. Could be related.

alex: Traffic pattern: many long-lived bidirectional streams (chat/assistant) where clients are idle for >60s between messages. If stream_idle_timeout is 60s at the LB, that will drop the connection mid-session and clients see GOAWAY/CANCELLED.

karen: Also noticing NAT egress port usage spike on node groups in the same time window. With heavy fan-out each worker opens many upstream connections to model backends, hitting ephemeral port reuse and causing TCP resets for new flows.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0473. Paging oncall. Labels: edge, grpc, network.

maria: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Increase `stream_idle_timeout` on the edge LB to 10m for affected clusters. 2) Enable HTTP/2 keepalive pings (`http2_keepalive_interval=30s`) so intermediaries don't consider streams idle. 3) Tweak proxy buffer sizes to avoid large memory pressure that can trigger premature connection termination. Rolling to canary now. :thumbsup:

sam: Applying config to canary now. Commands I'm running:
```
kubectl -n infra set configmap edge-proxy-config --from-literal=stream_idle_timeout=10m --from-literal=http2_keepalive_interval=30s
kubectl rollout restart ds/edge-proxy -n infra
```
Watching envoy logs for GOAWAY events to reduce.

jamie: Parallel action: I'll revert the earlier flush change on the canary envoy build and run a targeted test that simulates idle long-lived streams + NAT churn. Also opening a test harness to replay production traffic pattern against the LB. Long-term: add an integration test covering HTTP/2 stream idle + keepalive semantics.

alex: Good. Also monitor NAT port metrics (node_exporter/ephemeral_ports) and edge-lb/streams dashboards. If errors drop below 0.2% in 30 minutes we can consider this mitigated.

maria: Update 12m after config push: error rate dropped from 1.6% to 0.33%. GOAWAY logs decreased significantly on canary. NAT ephemeral port usage still elevated on worker pools — I'm coordinating with compute team to expand ephemeral port range on the node image and to add connection pooling on the model proxies.

karen: Opening a follow-up to increase ephemeral port range + add eBPF-based connection reuse metrics. Also recommending a short-term scale-up of NAT gateway capacity for us-west-2 to reduce port churn.

alex: Thanks all. Plan: keep the stream_idle_timeout and keepalive change for 24h; if stable, roll to prod clusters. Jamie to PR envoy revert and tests. Sam to watch rollout for 1h, Maria to update incident after 30m.

maria: Will post final numbers in 30m.

(attachments: logs snippet pasted into thread by sam)

[2024-07-01T02:34:12Z] upstream error: connection reset by peer
